title: Check: Effect of Surface Area on Rate (2)

questions.stem: Flour dust in mills can cause dangerous explosions. Why is flour powder so much more reactive than a solid block of flour?

options.text: Flour dust is chemically different from solid flour
Flour dust has a lower activation energy than solid flour
Flour dust generates its own oxygen supply
Flour dust has a very large surface area exposed to oxygen, allowing extremely rapid combustion

questions.explanation: Flour dust suspended in air has an enormous total surface area exposed to oxygen. When a spark provides the activation energy, the flour reacts (combusts) extremely rapidly because so many particles are in contact with oxygen simultaneously. This rapid reaction produces gases that expand violently, causing an explosion.
